entities.name: Afdhal al-Din abu Hamid Kermani
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Afzal al-Din Kermani was a Persian historian, author, poet, philosopher, and physician in the early 12th and early 13th centuries. He wrote the books Aghd Al ala Lel Moghefe Al ahla and Badayeh o Zaman Fi Vaghayeh Kerman about the geography and history of Kerman.
